text: Carpentry is a skilled occupation focused on building, fixing, and treating wood items and frameworks. This work demands patience, accuracy, and deep knowledge of timber properties. Tradespeople employ many instruments, though the saw and sander remain foundational tools. Cutting transforms raw lumber into specific shapes or lengths through sawing; sanding then refines rough surfaces to achieve a polished result. Adequate sanding prevents cracking and splitting by smoothing the grain, whereas sawing provides the necessary components for assembly. Neither operation stands alone; both integrate with methods such as joinery and finishing to produce long-lasting, visually appealing structures.
